context: Daichi watches Sho play in a competition.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: しょう、競争、本当、激しい、ね。
lines.en: Sho, competition really does get intense, doesn't it.
lines.style: Warm Kansai lilt underneath. Open and encouraging, leaning in. Soft chuckle of recognition—not pitying, just seeing him fully. The regional swing comes through naturally, no performance.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.en: I'm going to try my absolute best.
lines.style: Tiny voice, but steady. Eyes bright. The commitment in those words is real, not performed. Soft warmth—he means it. Small person, big intention.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.en: And I'll be cheering you on for sure.
lines.style: Kansai warmth wrapping around the promise. The 'de' at the end lands soft but certain. Leaning in—protective and genuine. No distance in this voice, all encouragement.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.en: It really has been fun, hasn't it.
lines.style: Small voice, reflective. A note of quiet wonder—he's noticing how good this feels. Soft trailing thought, like he's half-talking to himself, half-sharing with Daichi. Real and unguarded.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: 一緒に、頑張ろうな、絶対。
lines.en: Let's both give it everything we've got.
lines.style: Kansai warmth and firmness woven together. The promise lands clear. Shoulder-to-shoulder tone—not commanding, inviting. Soft Kansai roll at the end. Real tenderness underneath the resolve.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.style: Small, genuine voice. The gratitude is real—not reflexive. Quiet weight to each word. Soft fadeout on the last phrase, like he's still taking it in. No performance, just honest feeling.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.en: The same goes for me, truly.
lines.style: Kansai warmth meeting him in equal measure. The closing has weight—simple, sincere, matching his sincerity without overshadowing it. Soft and sure. The regional swing audible but never forced.
